title: Twelve Days at Roosevelt Rehabilitation Center & Walking Out for Good
description: From rushing a patronizing two-week Vocational Evaluation in a single week (where an evaluator actually suggests training them as a ValueMart door greeter), staying stuck as Level 2 clients, and getting written up for sleeping together in a closet to surviving the 'Chickenshit Report,' a chaotic dormitory room-assignment mix-up that sweeps a classmate's assault under the rug, and leaving Fishersville with Tina after twelve days.
